entities.summary: Christian Riesbeck is a Canadian Catholic prelate who currently serves as Bishop of Saint John, New Brunswick. He is a member of the Companions of the Cross. Christian Riesbeck was a religious figures from Montreal (b. 1970-02-07, Montreal). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
